component.name: Recents Filter
component.summary: Keep selected folders out of the GNOME recent files list

description.p: Recents Filter lets you pick folders whose contents must never appear in the GNOME Recent Files list, in any app.

GNOME has no native per-folder exclusion: GTK apps keep recording opened files in ~/.local/share/recently-used.xbel. Recents Filter ships a small inotify daemon that watches that file and purges excluded folders instantly when apps rewrite it, plus a GTK4/libadwaita configurator.
